triage.kind_span: The Fund is issuing subscription rights to its common shareholders to purchase the Fund’s common shares.

subject_names.span: “Fund,” refers to Clough Global Opportunities Fund

subject_tickers.span: The Fund’s common shares are traded on the NYSE American LLC under the symbol “GLO”

security_class.span: Subscription Rights to Purchase Common Shares

rights_per_share.span: Record Date Shareholders will receive one Right for each common share held on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: For every three Rights held, you are entitled to purchase one new common share of the Fund.

price_reference.span: The Subscription Price per common share will be determined based upon a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date.

price_pct.span: a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date

price_floor_pct_nav.span: a formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date

record_date.span: Rights will be issued to holders of record of the Fund’s Common Shares on May 25, 2021 (the “Record Date”).

expiration_date.span: The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on June 22, 2021, unless the Offer is extended as described in this Prospectus

transferable.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE American under the symbol “GLO RT”

over_subscription.span: Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise their Rights may also, in certain circumstances, purchase additional common shares pursuant to an Over-Subscription Privilege.

max_new_shares.span: subscribe for new common shares of the Fund in an aggregate amount of approximately 13,426,838 common shares (the “Offer”)

notes: 424B2 prospectus supplement dated May 21, 2021 for a transferable rights offering by Clough Global Opportunities Fund (GLO; rights trade as GLO RT). Subscription price is the higher of 85% of reported NAV or 95% of market price on the Expiration Date, market price being the average of last reported sales prices for the five trading days preceding the Expiration Date. Encoded as price_reference greater_of_nav_and_market with price_pct 95 (applied to market) and price_floor_pct_nav 85 (the NAV leg acts as a floor); a reviewer may prefer price_pct 85 or price_reference market. Estimated Subscription Price $11.83 as of May 14, 2021. Subscription period commences on or about May 27, 2021. Over-subscription privilege may be eliminated by the Board in its absolute discretion. The 13,426,838 shares are stated as 'approximately'. Only one expiration date (June 22, 2021) is stated; no extension in this filing.
